It includes 15 BGM composed by Momoko Sapporo and Shinichiro Matsumoto, as well as a full-size version of the theme song "Adabana Yumeutsutsu" sung by Rita.

For more information, please visit the following pages
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1357970/__Adabana_Odd_Tales_Soundtrack/

At the same time, you'll also get 10% off " ATRI -My Dear Moments-"!
If you purchase the two titles in a bundle,you can save an additional 10% off!

Don't miss this opportunity.
